title: ononis repens subsp. spinosiformis
intro: Ononis repens subsp. spinosiformis, commonly known as Spiny Restharrow, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is a perennial herb with thorny stems and leaves, used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Spiny Restharrow include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiarrheal properties, which can aid in wound healing, digestion, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
